# Synthetic Artwork

These deterministic abstract patterns are generated by `scripts/generate_test_artwork.py` using only the Python
standard library. They contain no movie posters, film stills, or third-party application screenshots, and are
distributed under the project's GPL-3.0 license.

Filenames match existing fictional image-server fixture routes; the images do not depict the named films.
Tests load these committed PNG files without network access or access to local prototype assets.

Regenerate with `python3 scripts/generate_test_artwork.py`.
